theory: The assertion that a flow-network table is necessarily not symmetric is too absolute: directed edges do not by themselves prohibit equal-capacity edges in opposite directions. State that reverse entries must be read independently and need not match; the supplied booklet defines weighted directed networks and capacities at lines 58–64 but provides no table-construction teaching beyond the syllabus objective at lines 39–40.
